vinyl-plank-flooring/venice.title: Vinyl Plank Flooring Venice FL | LVP for Wellen Park
vinyl-plank-flooring/venice.description: Vinyl plank and SPC installation across Venice, FL, from Wellen Park's new-build slab homes in Gran Paradiso and IslandWalk to Bay Indies manufactured homes.
vinyl-plank-flooring/venice.h1: Vinyl Plank Flooring in Venice: Wellen Park to Bay Indies
vinyl-plank-flooring/venice.lede: Vinyl plank flooring shows up across Venice in three very different subfloor situations, and the right wear layer depends on which one you're standing on.
vinyl-plank-flooring/venice.capsule: Vinyl plank flooring is the first call for Wellen Park first-owners in Gran Paradiso, Grand Palm and IslandWalk swapping builder carpet within a year of closing, and it works over Bay Indies' manufactured-home subfloor when rated for it. Near the immediate Venice Island waterfront, where AE and VE flood zones apply, we lean toward fully waterproof product. Typical 2026 installed ranges run $1.75-$9.50 per sq ft depending on wear layer.
vinyl-plank-flooring/venice.body_html:
Wellen Park is where most of our vinyl plank flooring calls in Venice originate these days. Neal Communities, Mattamy Homes, Lennar and DR Horton are all building at once across Gran Paradiso, Grand Palm, IslandWalk, Renaissance and Tortuga, and it's common for a first-owner to swap the builder-grade carpet in the main living areas within a year of closing, sometimes before they've hosted a single holiday on it. A 1,650 sq ft Gran Paradiso great room, kitchen and hallway run would typically go in over two to three days once the carpet and tack strips are pulled, since these slabs are only a few years old and rarely need self-leveling before the new floor goes down.

South Venice and Venice Gardens are a different starting point: older, established ranch homes on slab, often with a prior owner's tile or aging vinyl composition tile already down. Those jobs usually add tile removal and a slab moisture reading before we commit to a wear layer, since a 1970s-80s slab hasn't always been sealed to the standard a 2020s Wellen Park pour has. Bay Indies, the 55-and-over manufactured-home community near Curry Creek, is its own case again; vinyl plank works there, but only in a product rated for a raised chassis subfloor rather than a slab, and we check the fastening method before quoting rather than assuming a standard glue-down will hold.

The one place we're cautious about vinyl plank in Venice is the immediate waterfront on Venice Island, where AE and VE flood zones still apply even though 80-90% of the island sits outside a mapped flood zone. Standard SPC handles humidity fine, but for a property that could see actual storm-surge water against the floor, we point owners toward fully waterproof flooring built for that scenario rather than a standard click-lock product. If you searched for flooring installers near me from anywhere between Wellen Park and the island, see the Venice area page for the rest of the neighborhood breakdown, or check SPC vs. WPC core for which wear layer suits your slab.
vinyl-plank-flooring/venice.cost_html:
A 1,650 sq ft Gran Paradiso great room, kitchen and hall run in mid-range 20-mil SPC ($2.75-$5.50 installed) typically prices between $4,538 and $9,075 in 2026, carpet and tack-strip removal included. Stepping up to premium 22-plus mil SPC pushes the same square footage to $7,013-$12,375, while wide-plank luxury vinyl runs $9,075-$15,675.

A Bay Indies manufactured-home job usually runs smaller, closer to 900-1,100 sq ft, and stays in the standard-to-mid-range tier since the product needs to suit the subfloor more than the finish. See the vinyl plank flooring cost guide for tile-removal add-ons if your slab has old VCT underneath.

faqs.q: How soon do Wellen Park homeowners replace the builder carpet?
faqs.a: Many Gran Paradiso, Grand Palm and IslandWalk first-owners swap it for vinyl plank within the first year of closing, since the slab underneath is new construction and rarely needs anything more than a moisture check before the new floor goes down.

faqs.q: Can vinyl plank flooring go in a Bay Indies manufactured home?
faqs.a: Yes, if it's a product rated for a raised chassis subfloor rather than a concrete slab. We check the manufactured home's fastening requirements before quoting it like a standard site-built house.

faqs.q: Is vinyl plank flooring safe on the Venice Island waterfront?
faqs.a: Standard SPC handles Gulf Coast humidity without trouble, but the AE and VE flood zones along the immediate waterfront call for fully waterproof flooring instead, since actual storm-surge water is a different problem than everyday moisture.
